description: Cuzom's shared Renovate settings: dependency updates, and a check against every new handbook and dev-tools version. Use them with: "extends": ["github>cuzom-dev/dev-config"]. This repository is public on purpose - Renovate gives a public repository a token scoped to that repository alone, so a public repository cannot read a preset that lives in a private one.

packageRules.description: Node.js waits longer than the 3-day hold so version managers (mise, asdf) have caught up
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI passes
Major updates need approval on the Dependency Dashboard and a manual merge

TypeScript 7 waits for typescript-eslint, which refuses it (8.70.1 declares typescript <6.1.0). The pull request stays open with a note instead of waiting for approval: its CI fails until typescript-eslint supports 7, then turns green once Renovate rebases it. The rule only matches below 7, so it retires itself.
prBodyNotes: **Do not merge yet.** TypeScript 7 waits until typescript-eslint supports it: 8.70.1 declares `typescript <6.1.0` and stops with "typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0". In a repository that uses `@cuzom/eslint-config`, it also needs a dev-config release that allows TypeScript 7. Keep this pull request open: closing it tells Renovate to ignore TypeScript 7. Once typescript-eslint supports 7, this pull request is rebased and its CI turns green; tick the rebase box below if it stays red.

packageRules.description: A new handbook or dev-tools version is a check to do, not an update to merge: the pull request lists what changed, a person or an agent brings the repository in line, and a person merges
A major version of the handbook or dev-tools changed a rule: this repository no longer complies until it is checked and fixed
